calls.thesis: BUY first tracked. Ford is a buying opportunity at ~$11: forward P/E of just 6, Wall Street forecasts 28% EPS growth over the next several years, and policy has turned in Ford's favour (EV mandate scrapped, tariffs easing). Operating margin is only 1.8% and autos are never very lucrative, but the valuation more than reflects that.
calls.base_case: Margins recover to low-to-mid single digits as Ford refocuses on ICE models like the F-150; average selling prices keep rising.
calls.bull_case: Tariffs keep falling (Supreme Court rulings, friendlier Canada relations) and F-150 ICE demand stays strong.
calls.bear_case: Margins stay near 2% and tariffs persist, capping returns despite the cheap multiple.
